Elaila's dungeon run spirals into absolute chaos! The slime inside her decides to exit, triggering a massive body change. But the traps aren't done yet—tentacles, magic flowers, and cursed statues await.

I will be sincerely glad if you can support me on https://www.patreon.com/SirNrei, there you will gain access to new chapters of my comics a month or two earlier before I publish them publicly, and you will also get many other bonuses. Thanks to everyone who already supports me, this is extremely motivating to work further and create better comics.
